highlightAliases.new: PAMORAs for opioid-induced constipation — naldemedine and naloxegol counter opioid effects in the gut. Pooled response rates on p1378 are 52% vs 35% and 42% vs 29%, respectively. The pivotal trials measured spontaneous bowel movements, without requiring a sense of complete evacuation. Responders had at least three per week and at least one more than baseline for nine of twelve weeks, including three of the last four. COMPOSE trials · KODIAC trials
